name: EEG Foundation Challenge
description: The EEG Foundation Challenge consists of two tasks: predicting behavioral performance (response time) in the Contrast Change Detection (CCD) task using EEG data and demographic traits, and predicting continuous latent psychological constructs (e.g., internalization, externalization, attention, and the p-factor) using EEG data and demographic traits.

cr:input.name: HBN-EEG Dataset
cr:input.description: High-density EEG recordings with 128 channels, demographic traits (age, gender, handedness), and psychological factors (internalization, externalization, attention, p-factor). EEG data is formatted as X ∈ R^(128 × t), where 128 is the number of electrodes and t is the number of time steps. Event labels are Y ∈ R^(k × t), where k is the number of event labels. Demographic and psychological traits are P ∈ R^7.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predicted response times for the CCD task (continuous values between 0.5 and 2.5 seconds) and predicted continuous psychopathology scores (internalization, externalization, attention, p-factor).

field.name: response_time
field.description: Predicted response time for the CCD task, in seconds. Example: 1.75.

packages: [FILL IN THE BLANK: exact package versions]

cr:evaluation.notes: nRMSE is calculated as RMSE divided by the standard deviation of the true values. For Challenge 1, it evaluates response time predictions. For Challenge 2, it evaluates predictions of psychopathology scores.
